# SD13-E2 deterministic Half-Elf Fighter level 1 race-semantics recognition
# fixture. Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Half-Elf Fighter level 1
# identity as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values.
#
# Unlike Dwarf/Elf/Gnome (a fixed racial ability-score pair), PF1 Core Half-Elf
# grants a player-chosen +2 to any one ability score, mirroring the Human
# ability-bonus mechanic's shape (a named choice, not a fixed pair).
#
# The Fighter combat baseline, total saves, and selected-skill modifiers stay
# claim-blocked on this input because the bounded GE-06 Fighter compute path is
# grounded only for race:human; that is expected and unrelated to this fixture's
# purpose, which is to make the bounded Half-Elf race-semantics recognition
# legible. It deliberately avoids every unproven Half-Elf family: no Elven
# Immunities (sleep immunity, enchantment save bonus), no Adaptability (bonus
# Skill Focus feat), no Keen Senses Perception bonus, and no Multitalented
# favored-class posture.
case_id=pf1-crb-half-elf-fighter-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:half-elf
class_level=class:fighter:1
ability=strength:12
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:12
choice=choice:half_elf_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
